Name: Foundry Doctor Preflight What-If, subscription scope (optional addendum, sample)
Description: OPTIONAL variant of preflight-whatif-role.json for templates with targetScope = subscription. What-if of a subscription-scope deployment needs Microsoft.Resources/deployments/* at the subscription, so this role is assignable at subscription scope, which is broader than the resource-group variant: use it only when the template really deploys at subscription scope. Same caveats: not read-only, the doctor only sends the what-if POST and never deploys, and the template's resource write actions must be added or granted separately. Assign together with preflight-role.json. Review before assigning.
